title: Solving VeriContest with a Lean-Backed Rust Verifier
abstract: arXiv:2610.03994v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: VeriContest is a benchmark of 1007 competitive-programming problems in Rust, each with a Verus specification, a judge-accepted solution, and a Verus proof. Its authors report that proof generation is the bottleneck for frontier models: given the specification and the code, the best model produces an accepted Verus proof for 13.95% of the problems on the first attempt. We report on solving the same proof-generation task with Rust-Prover, a verifier for Rust backed by Lean 4. The Verus specification and the Rust code are restated and translated into Lean, each specification becomes a theorem, and agents prove the theorems with Lean's kernel as the final check. All 1325 theorems of all 1007 problems were proved. 1259 of them were proved in one run of under 32 hours on Claude Opus 5.5, at a median of 3.2 minutes and $1.17 per proof, and 70% of them on the first iteration. translated_title: 使用基于Lean的Rust验证器求解VeriContest
translated_abstract: VeriContest是一个包含1007道Rust竞赛编程题目的基准测试，每道题目都附有Verus规范、一个通过评测的解答以及一个Verus证明。其作者报告称，证明生成是前沿模型的瓶颈：在给定规范和代码的情况下，最强的模型首次尝试仅能对13.95%的题目生成被接受的Verus证明。我们报告了使用Rust-Prover——一个由Lean 4支持的Rust验证器——来解决同样的证明生成任务。Verus规范和Rust代码被重新表述并翻译成Lean，每个规范都成为一个定理，由智能体证明这些定理，并以Lean的内核作为最终检查。全部1007道题目的1325个定理全部得到证明。其中1259个定理在Claude Opus 5.5上的一次运行（不到32小时）中完成证明，每个证明的中位耗时为3.2分钟、成本为1.17美元，且其中70%在首次迭代即告成功。重新表述的规范已与基准测试进行了核对（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出由Lean 4支持的Rust验证器Rust-Prover，将VeriContest基准中全部1007道题目的1325个定理完全证明，其中1259个定理在不到32小时内以中位3.2分钟、1.17美元的成本完成，大幅超越了此前最强模型13.95%的首试通过率。
